chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, from Dawud ibn Farqad, from his brother who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'The arrogant ones will be made into the form of particles, and people will trample upon them until Allah is finished with the Reckoning.'

key_terms.الْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ: The arrogant / those who display pride

ai.seo_question: What happens to the arrogant on the Day of Judgment according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In al-Kafi, Shaykh al-Kulayni records Imam al-Sadiq (AS) describing the physical manifestation of arrogance as a degradation to the form of 'dharrah' (tiny particles or dust), symbolizing the loss of dignity and status. This eschatological punishment serves as a direct counterpoint to the worldly elevation sought by the arrogant, ensuring they remain trampled by people until the final completion of divine reckoning. The imagery underscores the Shia theological view that pride is not merely a spiritual flaw but a condition that alters one's ontological standing in the Hereafter.
